categories.real_regression: A code change broke behaviour the tests assert. The fix is in the changed code.
categories.flaky: The test itself is unreliable. Fails on some runs and not others, independent of the commit.
categories.dependency: A package version is incompatible. Code and tests are unchanged and correct.
categories.environment: Config or environment is wrong (env vars, pytest config, missing files). Code is correct.
categories.timeout: The job exceeded its time limit rather than failing an assertion.
categories.build: The Docker image failed to build. The Python test job is unaffected.
